item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.


What you will learn about:

  • How 3GPP standards from Release 15 to Release 19 built the foundation of NR-NTN, and why NTN extends 5G coverage to oceans, rural regions, and disaster zones.
  • How transparent and regenerative satellite payload architectures differ, and what each choice means for round trip time, link budget, and hardware complexity.
  • Why long distances, fast-moving satellites, and Doppler shift challenge the physical layer, including synchronization, timing advance, and HARQ operation.
  • How mobility works in NTN, including cell selection, conditional handover, feeder link switchover, and movement between terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks.
  • How to test NTN devices, satellites, and networks with RF, protocol, and over-the-air methods under realistic fading and propagation conditions.
  • How NTN evolves toward 6G unified networks that combine multiple bands, layers, and dimensions, with sensing, positioning, and AI.

item.title: 🟠 Engineer Overhead Lines to Withstand Ice, Wind and FreezingRain
item.description:
Why this matters: Service impact is possible — verify vendor status before troubleshooting internally.


This White Paper explains how ice, wind and vegetation load overhead distribution lines at the same time. It shows engineers how to assess the complete line and compare resilience options.

What you will learn about:

  • How freezing rain, rime ice and wet snow add weight to conductors and change their shape in the wind.
  • Why a moderate wind on a heavily iced line can govern design, and how galloping and vegetation contact create outages.
